title: Recover VM setup callback ABI

model_roles.strategy_review: Sol role: read-only ABI and hypothesis review
model_roles.native_execution: Luna role: one full-unit native trial and host evidence

abi_findings: The original reads a 32-bit word from D_8015CC30_15D830+0x8C and reads/writes an 8-bit field at +0xD8; existing flags remain at +0xD4.
The callee func_80035690_36290 uses six LHU instructions for allocator argument positions 7-9 and 13-15; the research prototype now declares those as u16.
F37C calls the allocator at +0x60 with the final zero-float store in its delay slot at +0x64, publishes the returned pointer, then calls the two registration setters in order.
No direct external JAL reference to F37C was found in the pinned USA assembly; broader dynamic reachability remains unknown.

variant_accounting.historical_evidence: vm_next_ten_batch1.json reports one isolated 192-byte candidate with 5/18 direct matches, 1 relocation-shape match and 29 relocation-layout differences; no original object or first mismatch was retained.
variant_accounting.stop_reason: The predicted float-register discriminator failed, and no measured historical first mismatch is available to demonstrate improvement. No second variant was justified.

trial.hypothesis: Use one named positive float zero for allocator arguments 4-6, retain one loaded scale for args 10-12, and type allocator integer stack slots as u16, while preserving production global declarations and the observed owner offsets.
trial.link_command: make -j2 UV=uv build/usa/mnsg.elf (after unique object layout pack)
trial.candidate_against_rom: 115 byte mismatches / 36 words in the unit; all 36 word mismatches are within F37C
trial.next_difference: At +0x0C the candidate loads scale into $f0, where the original moves zero into $f0.
trial.compile_result: IDO compile succeeded without warnings; link succeeded with the inherited ELF RWX segment warning.

tests.focused_host_result: PASS 300/300 synthetic cases; bitwise float checks include positive/negative zero, infinities, a NaN payload, subnormal and deterministic arbitrary patterns; slot wrap, call order, pointer storage and untouched bytes checked.
tests.negative_control: A temporary mutant passed scale instead of positive zero for the first allocator float argument; ASan/UBSan test rejected it at the expected float-bit assertion.
tests.related_vm_host_result: PASS: existing VM choices/repeat/streams, inputs, resources, callbacks and dialogue-state harness passed; no shared-header or existing test-source changes were retained.

local_ci_initial_failure.cause: A temporary shared script_vm.h layout edit invalidated the stored source fingerprint.
local_ci_initial_failure.resolution: Reverted the shared-header edit and kept the observed F37C layout in its research candidate/test fixture; the original header hash and stored proof fingerprint agree again.

decision.full_rom_g2: NOT_RUN: the candidate full translation unit is not byte-exact
